C-FIX-012-TAB-CYCLE-RENDER.Name: Eliminate the tab-cycle render TypeError
C-FIX-012-TAB-CYCLE-RENDER.Summary: Diagnose and repair the state corruption exposed when the complete command-registry walk reaches tabs.cycleForward. The tab action must switch or safely no-op without a Vue render exception, and the temporary expected-warning allowance must be removed.
C-FIX-012-TAB-CYCLE-RENDER.Problem: FIX-012 reproduces a render-time TypeError after the accumulated affordance-audit prefix. Small isolated command pairs do not reproduce it, so the corrupting predecessor and the render consumer must be identified rather than hiding the final error.
C-FIX-012-TAB-CYCLE-RENDER.ApprovalBasis: The owner instructed the standard GRACE plan, verification and two-clean-review workflow for the agreed post-2.6 stabilization boundary on 2026-10-20. Windows/Linux-specific product work remains excluded.

Goals.Goal: Reduce the exact full-walk reproducer to the corrupting command/state transition and fix the owning renderer boundary.
Remove FIX-012 from EXPECTED_BRIDGE_WARNINGS and keep every subsequent command warning-free.

Constraints.Constraint: Do not catch or suppress the Vue exception at the menu bridge.
Preserve valid tab-cycle wrapping and existing command behavior.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No tab UX redesign, cross-platform window chrome work, version, tag or release publication.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The exact affordance-audit registry walk completes with no tabs.cycleForward warning and no render TypeError.
A focused regression captures the corrupting prefix and asserts valid renderable state at the owner boundary.
Existing tab-cycle store and command tests remain green.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: npx vitest run tests/renderer/store/editor.test.ts tests/renderer/store/editor-deep.test.js tests/renderer/store/editor-deep2.test.js tests/renderer/commands/index.test.js
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: No FIX-012 allowlist entry, no menu-bridge warning, and focused state/render regression.

Assumptions.Assumption: Implementation waits for failing-first reduction of the existing exact reproducer; the repair file list may narrow after attribution but may not expand beyond M-011/M-012 without amending the approved spec.
